# WYLD

> Size-inclusive cycling, triathlon and run apparel from WYLD: race-fit and club-fit jerseys, bib shorts, trisuits, run tops and custom team kit, from XXS to 4XL. Official store and checkout: https://ridewyld.com. Prices in AED, synced daily (last sync 2026-09-28). Free shipping over AED 1,000.

WYLD is a cycling, triathlon and running apparel brand focused on size inclusivity, colour and comfort, with a custom team kit service for clubs and teams.

## Collections
- [Cycling](https://joaoccaldas.github.io/ai/studio/wyld-store/c/cycling/): Race-fit and club-fit cycling jerseys, bib shorts and gilets in bold WYLD colourways.
- [Triathlon](https://joaoccaldas.github.io/ai/studio/wyld-store/c/triathlon/): Trisuits made to be worn from swim to run.
- [Run WYLD](https://joaoccaldas.github.io/ai/studio/wyld-store/c/run/): Run WYLD tops: T-shirts, singlets and long sleeves in signature gradients.
- [Accessories](https://joaoccaldas.github.io/ai/studio/wyld-store/c/accessories/): Caps, swim ear plugs and gift cards for race week and beyond.
- [Sale](https://joaoccaldas.github.io/ai/studio/wyld-store/c/sale/): Current WYLD offers, synced daily from the official store.
